newsitem.title: USA: TEXACO CRUDE STORAGE TANK ON FIRE.
newsitem.headline: TEXACO CRUDE STORAGE TANK ON FIRE.

text.p: Texaco Inc said a crude storage tank with 113,000 barrels of crude near the mouth of Mississippi River was on fire after being struck by lightening Thursday night.

"The lightening caused what is called a 'rim fire' that is surrounding the tank. We are are going to attempt to extinguish the fire with foam in about 15 to 20 minutes," said Texaco spokesman Pierre De Gruy said at noon EDT/1600 GMT.
De Gruy said Texaco will not lose the crude if the tank is damaged.
"We have the capability of removing the crude if need be," he said. The tank has a total capacity of 125,000 barrels.
De Gruy said there were no injuries related to the fire which was near Pilottown, Louisiana.
